'''Nallok''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was captured on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and forced to become a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] dancer on a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]]. Planning her escape from servitude, Nallok learned how to pick locks, compromise security systems, and move stealthily. Before she would enact her plan, the yacht was attacked by an [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] team. Grateful for the rescue, Nallok joined the Alliance working as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]], [[Scout/Legends|scout]], and [[Procurement and Supply/Legends|procurement specialist]] throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During one mission, she was captured by the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]], [[Bennbus Polag]], and rescued by an Alliance team sent to find her.<ref name="ANM" />
